newsitem.title: USA: Rawlings to buy hockey business.
newsitem.headline: Rawlings to buy hockey business.

text.p: Rawlings Sporting Goods Co Inc said Monday it entered into a letter of intent to acquire the Victoriaville hockey business which includes the Vic, Victoriaville and McMartin brands.

Victoriaville has approximately $14.0 million in annual revenues and is expected to be modestly accretive to Rawlings' earnings in fiscal 1998. The transaction is expected to close in early September and is subject to completion of customary due diligence.
Jon Hodgins, Victoriaville's president, has agreed to manage the Rawlings' hockey business including the Rawlings, Vic, Victoriaville and McMartin brands.

"The acquisition of Victoriaville, including the tradition of the 50-year-old Vic and Victoriaville brands, will immediately accelerate our growth in hockey and the international marketplace," Carl Shields, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement. "The addition of hockey sticks and goalie protective equipment to the product line will improve our retail distribution."

He added that, beginning in 1998, the counter-seasonal nature of hockey and baseball should allow Rawlings to realize administrative cost savings and improve its fiscal fourth quarter results, which historically have been negatively impacted by the seasonality of Rawlings' business.
